comment: Form Post Basic plan only. The module puts response_mode=form_post only inside the request object; the query outside it keeps just response_type, client_id, scope and redirect_uri (REQUIRED_DUPLICATES in the suite's AbstractBuildRequestObjectRedirectToAuthorizationEndpoint at release-v5.3.4). pulsar does not support request objects (REQ-CORE-8), so it cannot read that response_mode, and returns request_not_supported in the query, the default Response Mode for the code flow. The module then skips, as in the Basic OP plan, but only after its form_post checks on the callback have failed.
